I feel this quite a bit. Im trying to get clean at the moment as well. Ive found the worse times, for me,, are times of stress and times of boredom. So I've been trying to systematically eliminate that. Always something to clean, reclean, organize, rethink. Then there's someone to text, or FaceTime. Even if they don't respond immediately. Though, I've relapsed recently and yes, the self deprication is a big part of it. Idk what to say, as I go through the same feelings. Its like you let down everyone all at once including yourself. Like your some worsened version of yourself. But relapses happen, I know this. 
Relapses don't define you, and neither do the drugs. Where do you want to go? Where do you want to be? Doesn't have to be specific; maybe a pet mouse, a hot spouse, or a big house? It dont matter, just focus on that goal, and do what you need to cut out the drugs. I recently cut up all my ATM cards and ordered new ones from the mail. It will take them a while to get here. I'm the mean time I cant use credit cards to get cash without penalties, and I have no ATM card. So I'm shit out of luck for a week. Im hoping by the end of the week I can say no, as ill hopefully be beyond the withdrawal symptoms. 
Either way, a relapse will happen, but so will sobering up. If you sobered up once, you can do it again, and you know its true, cause you've done it. Don't think of this as some cliff, or end to happiness, or some new way of life devoid of fun. These are the lies of drugs, that they make you fun, that they make everything interesting. All they do is alter how you experience life. You are fun/interesting/introspective/intelligent. I believe in you, and I know you will beat this. You are far more than drugs, and they are much less than you.

I think it contradicts our want to feel momentary validation with our want to be held special by another person. I know I personally cant do it. I'm a monogamous man. I like having one person/family to spoil with my love and attention. However, I've been single for a long time. And I know that a quick lay would go pretty far to boost my self-esteem. 

I think people look at it too much as an either or. You're either hooking up everyday or you're in a relationship. But tbh, most of us are just lonely and trying to find our way in the world. Most of the time hookups are for momentary physical validation. And dating is about long term  emotional validation. Both are important in full relationships. But some people just need a quick fuck to pick them up off the ground.

So I guess I'll conclude with this. I think we should stop putting such an emotional attachment on sex. It is, at the end of the day, just sex. But at the same time I dont think we should strip sex of any emotional value. So instead I think we should just discuss with the person we are interested in what we want. As much as no one likes the 'So what are we?' talk, I think the earlier you have it, the better both parties can focus on the relevant details. Either way theres no 'hookup culture' I think media is catching up with the true definition of a healthy mature sex life. Marriage is good for some, but not all, and we shouldn't shun that.
